questions.q: Should faith make sense? Why or why not?
questions.answer: Yes, even if not everything makes sense right away. God gave us minds and logic as tools for finding truth, and Jesus said to love God with all our mind.

questions.q: How do you use logic in your friendships to figure out what's true?
questions.answer: For example: if a friend's story doesn't add up, I think it through before I believe it. The lesson asks us to use that same careful thinking about Jesus.

questions.q: Which argument against Christianity sounds good until you think it through?
questions.answer: One example is "all religions are true." It sounds kind, but religions contradict each other on big things, like who Jesus is, so they can't all be true.
